from manim import *

class StickmanScene3(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Set background color
        self.camera.background_color = "#E8C15A"

        # Colors and styles
        stroke_color = BLACK
        stroke_width = 8
        fill_color = WHITE
        
        # Floor
        floor = Rectangle(width=config.frame_width, height=3, fill_color="#8F7A59", fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0)
        floor.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0)
        
        # Floor stones outlines
        path1 = ArcBetweenPoints(LEFT*7 + DOWN*2, RIGHT*7 + DOWN*2.5, angle=0.1, stroke_color=BLACK, stroke_width=4)
        path2 = ArcBetweenPoints(LEFT*7 + DOWN*1, RIGHT*7 + DOWN*0.5, angle=-0.1, stroke_color=BLACK, stroke_width=4)
        path3 = ArcBetweenPoints(LEFT*2 + DOWN*3, LEFT*3 + DOWN*1, angle=-0.2, stroke_color=BLACK, stroke_width=4)
        path4 = ArcBetweenPoints(RIGHT*2 + DOWN*3, RIGHT*3 + DOWN*0.5, angle=0.2, stroke_color=BLACK, stroke_width=4)
        
        # Shadow
        shadow = Ellipse(width=3, height=0.4, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.4, stroke_width=0)
        shadow.move_to(DOWN * 2.5)

        # Character Group
        character = VGroup()

        # Body
        body = Ellipse(width=1.9, height=3.3, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        body.move_to(DOWN * 0.2)

        # Head
        head = Circle(radius=1.3, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        head.next_to(body, UP, buff=-0.4)

        # Ears
        left_ear = Arc(radius=0.3, start_angle=PI/2, angle=PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        left_ear.next_to(head, LEFT, buff=-0.3)
        
        right_ear = Arc(radius=0.3, start_angle=-PI/2, angle=PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        right_ear.next_to(head, RIGHT, buff=-0.3)

        # Hair
        hair1 = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_top() + LEFT*0.4 + UP*0.0, head.get_top() + LEFT*0.7 + UP*0.5, angle=-PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        hair2 = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_top() + RIGHT*0.1 + UP*0.0, head.get_top() + LEFT*0.1 + UP*0.5, angle=-PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        hair3 = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_top() + RIGHT*0.5 + UP*0.0, head.get_top() + RIGHT*0.6 + UP*0.4, angle=-PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        hair = VGroup(hair1, hair2, hair3)

        # Eyes (half closed)
        eye_width = 0.8
        
        # Left eye
        left_eye_bottom = Arc(radius=eye_width/2, start_angle=PI, angle=PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        left_eye_top_line = Line(left_eye_bottom.get_left(), left_eye_bottom.get_right(), stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        left_pupil = Dot(radius=0.15, color=BLACK)
        left_pupil.move_to(left_eye_bottom.get_center() + DOWN*0.15)
        left_eye = VGroup(left_eye_bottom, left_eye_top_line, left_pupil)
        left_eye.move_to(head.get_center() + LEFT*0.45 + UP*0.3)

        # Right eye
        right_eye_bottom = Arc(radius=eye_width/2, start_angle=PI, angle=PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        right_eye_top_line = Line(right_eye_bottom.get_left(), right_eye_bottom.get_right(), stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        right_pupil = Dot(radius=0.15, color=BLACK)
        right_pupil.move_to(right_eye_bottom.get_center() + DOWN*0.15)
        right_eye = VGroup(right_eye_bottom, right_eye_top_line, right_pupil)
        right_eye.move_to(head.get_center() + RIGHT*0.45 + UP*0.3)

        # Eyebrows
        left_eyebrow = Line(left_eye.get_left() + UP*0.3 + RIGHT*0.1, left_eye.get_right() + UP*0.3 + RIGHT*0.1, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        right_eyebrow = Line(right_eye.get_left() + UP*0.3 + LEFT*0.1, right_eye.get_right() + UP*0.3 + LEFT*0.1, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)

        # Nose
        nose = Arc(radius=0.2, start_angle=PI, angle=PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        nose.move_to(head.get_center() + DOWN*0.1)

        # Mouth
        mouth = ArcBetweenPoints(head.get_center() + LEFT*0.6 + DOWN*0.5, head.get_center() + RIGHT*0.6 + DOWN*0.5, angle=-PI/8, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)

        head_group = VGroup(left_ear, right_ear, head, hair, left_eye, right_eye, left_eyebrow, right_eyebrow, nose, mouth)

        # Arms
        left_arm = ArcBetweenPoints(body.get_left() + UP*0.7 + RIGHT*0.1, body.get_left() + LEFT*1.4 + DOWN*0.2, angle=PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        left_forearm = ArcBetweenPoints(left_arm.get_end(), body.get_left() + DOWN*0.7 + LEFT*0.3, angle=PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        
        right_arm = ArcBetweenPoints(body.get_right() + UP*0.7 + LEFT*0.1, body.get_right() + RIGHT*1.4 + DOWN*0.2, angle=-PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        right_forearm = ArcBetweenPoints(right_arm.get_end(), body.get_right() + DOWN*0.7 + RIGHT*0.3, angle=-PI/4, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)

        # Hands
        left_hand = Ellipse(width=0.6, height=0.5, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        left_hand.move_to(left_forearm.get_end() + RIGHT*0.1)
        left_hand.rotate(PI/4)
        
        left_hand_finger = Arc(radius=0.15, start_angle=-PI/2, angle=PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        left_hand_finger.next_to(left_hand, DOWN, buff=-0.3).shift(RIGHT*0.2)
        
        right_hand = Ellipse(width=0.6, height=0.5, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        right_hand.move_to(right_forearm.get_end() + LEFT*0.1)
        right_hand.rotate(-PI/4)
        
        right_hand_finger = Arc(radius=0.15, start_angle=-PI/2, angle=-PI, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        right_hand_finger.next_to(right_hand, DOWN, buff=-0.3).shift(LEFT*0.2)

        # Legs
        left_leg = Line(body.get_bottom() + LEFT*0.4 + UP*0.1, DOWN*2.5 + LEFT*0.5, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        right_leg = Line(body.get_bottom() + RIGHT*0.4 + UP*0.1, DOWN*2.5 + RIGHT*0.5, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)

        # Feet
        left_foot = Ellipse(width=0.9, height=0.35, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        left_foot.move_to(left_leg.get_end() + LEFT*0.1)

        right_foot = Ellipse(width=0.9, height=0.35, stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width, fill_color=fill_color, fill_opacity=1)
        right_foot.move_to(right_leg.get_end() + RIGHT*0.1)

        character.add(left_leg, right_leg, left_foot, right_foot, left_arm, left_forearm, right_arm, right_forearm, body, left_hand, right_hand, left_hand_finger, right_hand_finger, head_group)
        
        # Save state for blink
        left_eye.save_state()
        right_eye.save_state()

        # Animations
        self.play(FadeIn(floor), FadeIn(path1), FadeIn(path2), FadeIn(path3), FadeIn(path4), FadeIn(shadow))
        self.play(Write(character), run_time=3)
        self.wait(1)
        
        # Blink animation
        blink_left = Line(left_eye_bottom.get_left(), left_eye_bottom.get_right(), stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)
        blink_right = Line(right_eye_bottom.get_left(), right_eye_bottom.get_right(), stroke_color=stroke_color, stroke_width=stroke_width)

        self.play(Transform(left_eye, blink_left), Transform(right_eye, blink_right), run_time=0.15)
        self.play(Restore(left_eye), Restore(right_eye), run_time=0.15)
        self.wait(2)
